title: AffineNormalization coordinates for smooth purity
statement: Use [def-pur-transport-affine-integration], [det-sp-finite-general-ring]. The affine normalization property of an adjunction family is the following equality for every finite commutative ring killed by a positive power of $\ell$ and every scheme $Y$ in the standing setting. Its counit for the affine-line projection, evaluated on the coefficient unit, after the fixed sectionwise encoding and unit comparison equals: compact-support encoding comparison, compact support of the canonical source-on-unit and root-normalized finite-line comparisons, the recorded compact-support site comparison, and the site image of ordinary affine integration. The finite line and unit coordinates satisfy their generator normalizations; invertibility and bounded-below witnesses are conclusions of the property. Together with the scalar counit property this is the normalization of the integral, rational and closure family.
